title: Security questionnaire desk
summary: Answer vendor security questionnaires from labelled house knowledge. Fans out per question via Batch; anything not in knowledge is marked for a human rather than invented.

requires_connections.name: security-email
requires_connections.why: Return the completed packet (after you approve) from an address the vendor already has.

input._why_daily: A packet that arrives at 4pm is still on the desk in the morning. A weekly tick hides five days of silence.
input._why_only_one_schedule: fill_questionnaire takes one packet. Scheduling it empty would burn a run with nothing to parse. The morning sweep finds the work.

the evidence pack; anything not written here is answered `needs_human` rather than invented, so an
empty section is safe — it is not a claim that the control is absent, only that nobody has written
it down yet.

One bullet per control, each ending in where the evidence lives (a document name, not a link that
